hints: The structure is the same as the matrix version. The only change is how you choose the next vertex: extract from the heap instead of scanning.
Whenever you improve dist[v], insert a fresh (dist[v], v) entry. Do not try to find and modify the old one - just leave it there.
The stale check is one line at the top of the loop: if (it.key > dist[u]) continue; Without it you re-expand vertices and the work blows up.
source: Combines Week 4 SSSP with the Lab 11 priority queue
title: Dijkstra with a priority queue
